raw_definitions: Definisi : adv recently, baru: - cut grass, rumput yg baru dipotong; ~ - fallen snow, salji yg baru turun; ~ - laid, baru: ~ - laid eggs, telur baru. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)

Definisi : adj baru, baharu: a ~ set of furniture, set perabot yg baru; ~ developments, perkembangan baru; he likes his ~ job, dia menyukai pekerjaan barunya; a ~ member of the club, ahli baru kelab itu; this place is ~ to me, tempat ini baru bagi saya; ~ baby, orang baru; ~ look, wajah baru; the ~ rich, orang kaya baru; the ~ mother, wanita yg baru menjadi ibu; the ~ woman, wanita baru; as good as ~, elok spt baru; (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
